name: Webex Channel
description: Cisco Webex messaging integration for OpenClaw

token.description: Webex bot access token from developer.webex.com

webhookUrl.description: Public URL for receiving Webex webhooks

allowFrom.description: List of allowed person IDs or emails (when dmPolicy is allowlisted)

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts for failed API calls

agent.description: OpenClaw agent id this account dispatches to. Defaults to "main". Set to a specific agent id when running multiple bots on the same gateway, each routed to a different agent.

progressStreamReasoning.description: When true, stream the agent's reasoning text live into the Webex progress message instead of the static "💭 Thinking…" label. Opt-in because raw reasoning occasionally contains internal deliberation or echoed context users didn't intend to see; redaction is best-effort.

token.label: Bot Access Token
token.placeholder: Your Webex bot token from developer.webex.com

webhookSecret.label: Webhook Secret
webhookSecret.placeholder: Strong random secret for webhook verification
